content.short: Sahara AI is a decentralized AI blockchain network designed for the equitable ownership and sharing of AI assets.
content.description: Sahara AI is a pioneering decentralized Layer 1 blockchain specifically engineered to power the emerging agentic economy. The platform provides a secure and transparent framework for users to create, share, and monetize AI assets—including advanced models, high-quality datasets, and autonomous agents—while maintaining total ownership and provenance. Sahara utilizes its proprietary blockchain infrastructure to ensure that every contribution is fairly rewarded and that AI development remains open and inclusive. By providing the infrastructure for verifiable and privacy AI.
